scenario: LUNI.4.3 — slot type position admits IDENT-shape unit dimension names (e.g. `currency_usd`) in addition to TYPE_NAME builtins / schema names. Pin: a schema declaring a `currency_usd`-typed slot compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
unit dimension currency_usd  storage int64  base USD_cent
unit USD_cent: currency_usd

schema Order scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    amount: currency_usd mutable
